reasoning_content: NDK 27.0.12077973 is already installed. Next, create a debug keystore with keytool for the release signing configuration, and write key.properties. key.properties is gitignored, so it won't pollute the repo (no wait — it's inside the android/ directory, and it's in .gitignore so no problem; the installation guide doesn't mention it, but a release build can't be built without it; creating a local keystore is a reasonable setup step).

action.command:
cd /workspace/android && keytool -genkeypair -v -keystore release.keystore -alias umweltnavi -keyalg RSA -keysize 2048 -validity 10000 -storepass umweltnavi123 -keypass umweltnavi123 -dname "CN=UmweltNAVI, OU=Dev, O=Dev, L=Berlin, C=DE" 2>&1 | tail -2 && printf "storeFile=release.keystore
storePassword=umweltnavi123
keyAlias=umweltnavi
keyPassword=umweltnavi123
" > key.properties && ls -la key.properties release.keystore
